definitions.explanation: Purified cotton with the natural oils removed, used for cleaning wounds, applying disinfectant, and other medical purposes because it absorbs liquid readily.

examples.japanese: {脱脂綿|だっしめん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{傷口|きずぐち}→傷口：09517_kizuguchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消毒|しょうどく}した→消毒する：17818_shoudokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I disinfected the wound with absorbent cotton.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬局|やっきょく}→薬局：01069_yakkyoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{脱脂綿|だっしめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought absorbent cotton at the pharmacy.

examples.japanese: {脱脂綿|だっしめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{消毒液|しょうどくえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{含|ふく}ませて⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧。
examples.english: I soak absorbent cotton with disinfectant and wipe the skin.

notes:
{脱脂|だっし} (degreased) + ⟦{綿|わた}→綿：00421_wata⟧ (cotton): raw cotton with its natural oils and waxes removed so it absorbs liquid instead of repelling it. Standard first-aid and medical supply item.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脱脂綿|だっしめん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{消毒|しょうどく}する→消毒する：17818_shoudokusuru⟧: to disinfect with absorbent cotton
- {脱脂綿|だっしめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{当|あ}てる→当てる：01864_ateru⟧: to press absorbent cotton against (a wound)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{綿|わた}→綿：00421_wata⟧: ordinary cotton/stuffing, not purified for medical use
- ⟦コットン→コットン：30876_kotton⟧: the fashion/cosmetics-register cotton word; コットンパフ (cosmetic pads) are a related but separate product from medical {脱脂綿|だっしめん}
